ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity region covering the central and proximal fluke areas. acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white scarring or colonization clusters at the lobe tips; distinct indentation/notch visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Fibrous or fringed texture visible at the extreme distal point of the right lobe tip.
